name: Tanta Ginting
bio:
Ir. Tanta Jorekenta Ginting, better known as Tanta Ginting (born on October 15, 1981) is an Indonesian actor and musician. He gained widespread recognition after starring in various films, television series, and comedy shows.

Tanta initially pursued a career in music before eventually transitioning into acting. He lived in the United States for several years before returning to Indonesia to pursue a career in the entertainment industry. In the film industry, he has appeared in several notable titles such as Sundul Gan: The Story of Kaskus (2016), Wiro Sableng: Pendekar Kapak Maut Naga Geni 212 (2018), Ghost Writer (2019), and Siksa Kubur (2023).

Additionally, Tanta is active in television and digital series, including starring in the series Brata and various other productions. With his charismatic acting style and natural comedic talent, he continues to be one of the most prominent actors in the Indonesian entertainment industry.
